strip.dirty: ⚠ Required mods disabled — joining the server may fail
strip.offline: ⚠ Sync check failed — last synced: {time}. Playing last consistent state.
mods.emptyDesc: Drop files into the mods folder or use Add mods.
settings.directDesc: Join the server immediately on launch
settings.autoDesc: Apply manifest changes when you play
settings.verifyDesc: Re-hash all managed files and re-download only corrupted ones
settings.deleteDesc: Saves are moved to a backup folder first (default)
add.title: Add instance
add.manifestDesc: Paste the manifest URL from your server operator. Deep links skip this step.
add.manualDesc: Create an empty instance without a manifest. You manage mods yourself.
add.dupDesc: Instance '{name}' already uses this server manifest. What would you like to do?
add.manualMemo: Manual instances have no manifest sync. Every file is user-owned.
add.manualDetail: An instance you assembled yourself, without a manifest.
req.title: This mod is required by the server
req.desc: {name} is required to join the server. Disabling it may cause join failures or crashes. You can always "Reset to manifest state".
update.title: Apply update — {name}
update.desc: This download exceeds 200MB and needs confirmation.
browse.title: Add mods
browse.desc: Showing compatible versions only: {compat} · installed mods are user-owned and never auto-removed.
empty.title: No instances
empty.desc: Add your first instance with a manifest URL or deep link from your server operator.
err.title: Something went wrong
err.E-MF-01: Couldn't fetch the server configuration. Check your network and try again.
err.E-MF-02: The configuration file is corrupted. Please contact the server operator.
err.E-MF-03: A launcher update is required. Update to the latest version and try again.
err.E-MF-04: Some files failed to download. Your current installation is untouched. Retry, or contact the server operator if it keeps failing.
err.E-MF-05: This launcher only supports Minecraft 1.13 and above.
err.E-AU-01: Sign-in failed or was cancelled. Please try again.
err.E-AU-02: An Xbox profile is required. Create one on the Xbox website, then sign in again.
err.E-AU-03: Child accounts must be added to a Microsoft family group by a guardian.
err.E-AU-04: Korean accounts require Xbox adult verification. Complete it on your Xbox account page, then sign in again.
err.E-AU-05: This account doesn't own Minecraft. Check your purchase or Game Pass subscription.
err.E-AU-06: Your session expired. Please sign in again. Your instance list remains available.
err.E-JV-01: Couldn't set up the Java runtime. Retry, or set a Java path manually in Settings.
err.E-LD-01: Mod loader installation failed. Retry, or try a different loader version.
err.E-DL-01: Not enough disk space. Free up some space and try again.
err.E-MB-01: The author restricts in-launcher downloads for this mod. Download it from the official page and select the file.
err.E-GM-01: The game crashed. Check the crash report.
err.E-GM-02: The game crashed repeatedly in a short time, so auto-retry was stopped. Please check the diagnostics screen.
err.E-IN-01: An unexpected error occurred. Copy the error details and report it.
